zone.description: casjay-base default zone. nginx is the only public listener for web/cockpit (proxies to Apache on 81/8443 and Cockpit locally - neither is opened here); mail is exposed directly via Postfix and Dovecot, files via ProFTPD and rsyncd. DNS (bind) is docker-published on 53/tcp+udp, which traverses the FORWARD chain ahead of this zone and needs no entry here. Docker's own remote API and Apache's local listener stay unreachable by not being listed. ProFTPD's passive port range (49152-65534/tcp) matches PassivePorts in etc/proftpd.conf - keep both in sync if that value changes.
